collection.title: MG GS 2016 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The MG GS 2016 Onwards requires a 23" wiper blade on the drivers side and an 17" on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this GS, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
